messages:
Rae: opened a small PR to prune duplicate glossary entries and add canonical IDs for localized copies. moving 'inference runtime' -> canonical id: inference-runtime, removing near-duplicates like 'serving runtime (infra)'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1011
Tom: nice. are we also adding a short migration note for translators? some locales had slightly different terms that will break search.
Maya: yes pls. I'll add a short section: 'Localization note: keep canonical id unchanged; translate only the displayed label.' helps our l10n flow.
LocalizationBot: FYI: current crowdin project flags 12 glossary duplicates that will require upstream anchors to preserve context. See task #L10N-44.
Rae: good catch. also consolidating plural forms: 'replica' vs 'replicas' -> canonical id = replica (singular). we'll add redirect anchors for replicas -> replica.
Tom: add an example redirect line in docs/glossary.yml so l10n won't lose context. e.g., `replicas: alias_of: replica` (or whatever YAML style we use).
Maya: microcopy decision: prefer short labels in UI docs ("replica count") but keep glossary entries singular. leaving note in PR description.
Rae: code snippet updated to canonical handles:
```
# CLI
redwood deploy --model redwood-opt-2 --replicas 2
# SDK
client.create_deployment(model_handle="redwood-opt-2", replica=2)
```
Maya: tiny style ask: in localized docs we should avoid inline English-only acronyms. flagged in PR: replace 'SLA' with full form where necessary and keep acronym in parentheses once.
Tom: ack. also request: add one-line test that the site build picks up alias anchors; I added issue #1099 for site indexing checks.
docs-bot: reminder: keep PR small. follow-ups: l10n anchors (#L10N-44), site index test (#1099), normalize SDK casing per language (separate PRs).
Rae: done 389 added PR note: "follow-ups: l10n anchors, site-index test, per-language param casing". moving to reviewers. thanks everyone :wave:
